Callout.Name: Person in Clown Mask with a Weapon
Callout.Message: Person in a mask carrying a weapon, frightening the public.
Callout.Advisory: Person in a clown mask, weapon visible, no victims.

Script.Line: It is a mask. It is only a mask. The weapon is real enough though.
He has been stood there an hour and nobody will go near him.
He was asking people for money. That is why the first call came in.

Lines.Approach: They are in a mask and they have something in their hand, and they are enjoying the reaction.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
